children: Australia’s final demand producer price index (PPI) increased 1.1% Q/Q in the third quarter of 2026, topping market forecasts of 1.0% while moderating from the 1.3% pace set in the prior period.
On an annual basis, producer prices rose 3.6%, matching the previous quarter's rate and holding at the highest annual growth rate since Q1 2025.

Complementing the inflation data, private sector credit expanded 0.6% M/M in September 2026, slightly beating expectations of 0.5% and maintaining the steady expansion rate observed over the previous two months.
Driven by robust domestic corporate earnings alongside the economic data, the benchmark
climbed 1.1%, to 8,986 in Friday morning trading, extending prior strength.
